title: verify_user_authentication_with_jwt_token
description: Test the POST /api/v1/auth/login endpoint to ensure users can authenticate successfully with valid credentials and receive a JWT token.

title: verify_user_logout_and_token_invalidation
description: Test the POST /api/v1/auth/logout endpoint to ensure that the user's JWT token is invalidated and the session is properly ended.

title: verify_project_creation_with_unique_name_per_user
description: Test the POST /api/v1/project endpoint to ensure projects can be created with unique names per user and validate the maximum length constraint of 100 characters.

title: verify_project_retrieval_for_current_user
description: Test the GET /api/v1/project/current-user endpoint to ensure it returns the list of projects accessible to the authenticated user.

title: verify_block_creation_and_pagination_for_workflow_type
description: Test the POST /api/v1/block/workflow endpoint for creating workflow blocks with valid variables and types, and GET /api/v1/block/workflow/page for pagination and filtering.

title: verify_type_definition_and_inheritance_validation
description: Test the POST /api/v1/type endpoint to ensure custom data types can be created with valid fields and inheritance rules, and conflicts are detected and handled.

title: verify_service_creation_and_json_export
description: Test the POST /api/v1/service endpoint for creating services with required fields and validation, and GET /api/v1/service/file/{serviceId} for exporting service configuration as JSON.

title: verify_scenario_variable_management_and_workflow_execution
description: Test the POST /api/v1/scenario/{scenarioBlockId}/variables endpoint for adding variables to scenario blocks, and GET /api/v1/scenario/{workflowId}/variables/exit for retrieving exit variables.

title: verify_api_security_with_jwt_and_role_based_access
description: Test that all endpoints except login require a valid JWT token in the Authorization header and enforce role-based and project-level permissions.

title: verify_pagination_and_filtering_for_project_and_block_lists
description: Test pagination and filtering parameters on endpoints like GET /api/v1/project and GET /api/v1/block/{blockType}/page to ensure correct page counts and filtered results.
